back_translation: The LORD says this: "Maintain justice and do righteousness, for my salvation is about to arrive, and my righteousness is about to be revealed."
Happiness belongs to the man who does this, and to the son of man who holds it fast — who keeps the Sabbath from being profaned and guards his hand from doing any evil.
Let not the foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD say, "The LORD will surely separate me from his people." And let not the eunuch say, "Behold, I am only a dry tree."
For the LORD says this: "To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, who choose what pleases me and hold fast to my covenant —
I will give them a memorial and a name within my house and within my walls, better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name, a name that will never be cut off.

And as for the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD to minister to him, to love the name of the LORD, and to be his servants — everyone who keeps the Sabbath from being profaned and holds fast to my covenant —

I will bring them to my holy mountain and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on my altar, for my house will be called a house of prayer for all the peoples."
The Lord GOD, who gathers the scattered outcasts of Israel, declares: "I will gather still others to them besides those of them already gathered."
All you beasts of the field, come and eat — and all you beasts in the forest too.
His watchmen are blind; all of them know nothing. They are all mute dogs that cannot bark — dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.
Those dogs are greedy; they never know satisfaction. They are shepherds who know no understanding; they have all turned to their own way, each one seeking his own gain from every side.
They say, "Come, let us go get wine; let us drink our fill of strong drink! And tomorrow will be like today, or even far greater."
